name: Digital Predistortion and FPGA Implementation for RF Power Amplifier Linearization
summary: Master's research on RF power-amplifier behavioural modelling, memory polynomial Digital Predistortion and FPGA/VHDL-oriented implementation.

bullets.text: Developed Python reference models for RF power-amplifier behaviour and Digital Predistortion using memory polynomial structures.
Translated selected DSP structures into fixed-point VHDL datapaths for FPGA-oriented execution.
Compared Python fixed-point outputs with VHDL simulation results for bit-accurate validation.
Measured implementation characteristics including clock frequency, latency, resource use and simulation timing.
